integrity: Theorem proved analytically via compact localization and mixed linear-quadratic beta-ball integration. Finite code checks are supplementary and are not infinite proofs. The self-review is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: For each fixed integer n>=4, area-uniform interior points of one disk only. The n=3 specialization was already known in the historical record and is cited solely as a normalization check. No full area distribution, sample-size-uniform estimate, dependent-subset extreme-value theorem, or independent historical-priority certificate is asserted.
title: Sharp upper-area tails for disk-uniform random polygons of all fixed orders at least four
